BiblicalUsage: Darkness — the thick darkness over Egypt that could be felt, the blind groping of a disobedient people at noonday, and the promise that light will rise in obscurity for the one who feeds the hungry. The word names both judgment and the place where light is promised.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that darkness in Scripture is never just the absence of light; it is the judgment of God and the cry of his people at once. And I believe the promise stands with it: those who spend themselves for the hungry will see their darkness become noonday.
